method: Equal-weight delivery milestones: 100 * delivered / 20. Partial or unverified milestones count zero. These are delivery checklist percentages, not hardware accuracy, exhaustive domain coverage or retail compatibility.

milestones.acceptance: Separate core plugin and ABI entry points
Parse a native cartridge/executable format (boot scored separately)
Complete CPU instruction families, including architectural extensions
Complete native RAM/ROM map and ownership rules
Complete exceptions, privilege and address translation
Complete peripheral registers, interrupt producers and DMA
Native firmware/retail boot procedure
At least one locally tested retail title verified playable
Guest graphics produce rendered video
Guest sound produces audio samples
Hardware-referenced CPU/device/display/audio timing
Native digital controller/keypad registers consume frontend input
Complete native controller/touch/motion/analog peripheral behavior
Native local multiplayer/link input routing
Actual production-plugin TCP peers pass original guest oracle and whole-state comparison
Complete native persistent media types and persistence
Complete states for the implemented profile and deterministic replay
Repository-owned ROM source and reproducible archived image
Actual guest register-file output independently graded on the host, with negative controls
Original corpus covers the full native hardware, with physical reference validation

platforms.name: Nintendo 64
platforms.remaining: Cached SI/PIF reads refresh digital and signed-byte analog input. The original 65,536-coordinate corpus grades 1,048,576 actual words; frontend selected-stick mapping, neutral dead zone and canonical input recording are verified. Functional one-cycle E4/E5 rectangles share the existing triangle pixel pipeline; A six-billion-attempt Start/A probe reaches Mario, the lives/star HUD and Lakitu tutorial in the courtyard without a terminal CPU exception or RSP/DP stop. A shared private checkpoint now verifies courtyard analog walking, jumping and punching through RAM and neutral controls; 180 legacy quantum movie frames and six seek boundaries match full states. New native sessions advance to VI field boundaries; an original 5,160-case file oracle and 121 native VI movie frames verify scheduling and replay. Legacy states keep the old budget. Exact physical timing and practical normal-speed play remain unverified. Castle entry, menu/level progression and full-title playability remain unverified. All twelve signed/unsigned register/immediate integer trap instructions are implemented; the original 15,728,640-case corpus grades 188,743,680 actual RAM/CP0 words. Twenty-eight doubleword integer/LWU families now enforce User/Supervisor mode restrictions; the original 5,768,792-case mapped guest corpus grades 69,225,504 RAM/CP0 words, with executed NOP rejection and native rollback. Nine wide integer memory families now verify Kernel32 address formation across 4,718,592 original guest cases / 56,623,104 RAM/CP0 words, with extended-address/alignment controls and native rollback. CP0 BadVAddr/PRId/CacheErr software write protection now has an original 12,582,912-case cartridge / 150,994,944 actual RAM/register words, with hardware exception seeding, wrong-read rejection and native rollback. Config fixed/writable fields and actual K0 cache/bypass reads now have an original 16,777,216-case cartridge / 201,326,592 actual RAM/register words, with EP/BE defaults held and clock-field preservation controls. Status writable/reserved/TS write rules now have an original 4,194,304-case cartridge / 50,331,648 actual RAM/register words, with EXL held for safe readback and unconstrained component controls. TagLo/TagHi/PErr field writes now have an original 12,582,912-case cartridge / 150,994,944 actual RAM/register words and all physical-tag values in defined functional CACHE consumer controls. Complete CPU/CP0/devices, physical FPU/RSP timing, complete RDP/audio, two-cycle pixels and texture LOD, random dithering/noise and CI8 alpha thresholds, physical analog calibration/accessories/presence detection, CIC/EEPROM/Joybus and physical SI timing remain. Production two-player TCP rollback and four virtual digital/analog PIF ports are verified for the implemented profile. Ordinary frontend local multiplayer is independently graded through SDL virtual pads, the default input plugin and original guest SI RAM replies: 194 cases, all 24 device assignments, 14 controls on four ports and signed stick endpoints/dead zone. Extra players now have independent saved button/key/axis profiles relative to assigned devices: 3,026 real guest cases / 18,156 RAM words, with wrong-map rejection and remapped four-port native movies. Saved per-player analog axis/polarity/dead-zone/range profiles now have 4,035 ordinary frontend guest cases / 24,210 RAM words, with remapped movies and malformed-file rejection. Physical USB/Bluetooth validation, keyboard stick remapping, advanced stick shaping and full native accessories remain.

platforms.name: Nintendo Switch
platforms.remaining: Integer paired and single transfers now have original independently graded NSO images, executed controls and complete native-state replay. The new signed/unscaled/writeback/register-offset image checks 7,188,480 snapshots / 57,507,840 register words. Full AArch64 CPU/extensions/exceptions, native RAM/MMU/processes, compressed/hash-checked NSO and other formats, firmware/HOS/retail boot, graphics/audio, native controllers/devices, native saves, physical timing and complete original hardware corpus remain. Current execution is an original uncompressed NSO0 integer process profile; retail playability is unverified. Production TCP rollback now matches complete states and independently graded guest RAM for two synthetic input words; native Joy-Con/HID and HOS input services remain unfinished.
